# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-25 from the 2026-10-25 Hub dump.

- 3,182,810 models tracked, 905,466 declare a base model, 938,425 parent links, 89,177 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
